description: A non-streamed Gemini request with maxOutputTokens 16 to a Messages upstream that stops at the limit: the partial text comes back as one candidate whose finishReason is MAX_TOKENS, with the usage of the partial answer.

exceptions.reason: The new core writes the Gemini reply the same way for every upstream format: candidate index 0, one chunk per text or thought delta, a last chunk holding the finish reason, any function calls and usageMetadata with Gemini's inclusion rules (promptTokenCount counts every input token, cache reads included, in cachedContentTokenCount; a Messages upstream gives no separate thinking count, so all output tokens count as candidates), and max_tokens as MAX_TOKENS. Today's Claude translator adds createTime and usageMetadata.trafficType PROVISIONED_THROUGHPUT, leaves out the candidate index, reports a promptTokenCount of 0, maps a non-streamed max_tokens stop to STOP, and turns a Claude thinking signature into a thought part holding skip_thought_signature_validator, Google's last-resort value that skips validation; the new core does not invent a signature and reports the Claude one as dropped.

exceptions.reason: Today's core reaches a Messages upstream only through its Claude API-key provider and its Gemini-to-Claude translator, which rewrite the request even for a custom base URL: cache_control breakpoints, a metadata.user_id hashed from the request, $schema and additionalProperties false on tool schemas, the system instruction sent as a user message, temperature and top_p dropped, every request streamed, ?beta=true, and the key as a bearer token with its own Accept and Accept-Encoding. The new core sends a plain Messages request: the system instruction as system, the client's sampling options, stream as the client asked, and the key in x-api-key as Anthropic's API defines; Claude-specific rewrites belong to the Claude provider extension (slice 10).
